resources.string: Shows a taskbar on the main screen. It watches which app is open and whether the keyboard is showing, so it can show your recent apps and step aside when you type. It does not read the text or content inside your apps. It reads the colours on screen around the bar so its glass always contrasts with what is behind it, and keeps a picture of each app you use for the switching animations. Those pictures stay in this app\'s private storage on your phone, are never kept for secure screens such as banking apps, are deleted if you uninstall, and are never sent anywhere. With the Recede presence it also notices when the app beneath is scrolling, never what it shows.
